facts.fact: Aria 五分钟就融入全场，Kit 胸口剧痛：她比他五个月来任何时候都更属于这里。
facts.anchor: Something painful twists hard in my chest. I inhale shakily and have to blink several times against the sudden burn in my eyes. I don’t understand. How can someone so brand new just walk in here, smile like that, and immediately be allowed to talk to people and hug them? She’s been here five minutes and already belongs more than I ever have.

facts.fact: Aria 主动抱住他问名字。
facts.anchor: she leans over and pulls me into a warm, easy hug. “Hey, you must be the youngest. What’s your name?

facts.fact: Armen 尴尬解释：你不能碰 Kit。
facts.anchor: Oh, Aria, you um… you can’t touch Kit.

facts.fact: Soren 到场立规：他们不许跟他说话或碰他——想留下就尊重这一点、挪开。
facts.anchor: They don’t speak to him or touch him because they’re not allowed. I suggest if you want a place here you respect that and move.

facts.fact: Soren 俯身扯掉他的耳机：桌上不许听音乐。
facts.anchor: yanks the earbuds straight out of my ears, and drops them onto the table. “No music at the table, Kit.

facts.fact: Kit 心里默数：没音乐、没说话、没拥抱、没对视——只是活着，勉强算。
facts.anchor: No music, no talking, no hug, no eye contact. Just existing, barely.

facts.fact: 他猛地起身走向正门。
facts.anchor: I stand up so suddenly that several heads turn. My heart is slamming against my ribs hard enough to hurt, but I ignore it. I don’t head for the kitchen. I turn toward the main double doors of the dining room and start walking.

facts.fact: Soren 命令：Kit. Sit down.
facts.anchor: “Kit. Sit down.”

facts.fact: 他故意让门重重甩上。
facts.anchor: letting them slam shut behind me on purpose.

facts.fact: 他拒绝回去看 Aria 五分钟就拥有的东西——他被困十个月、只许跟 Lorraine 说话、全部家当三套衣服一双鞋。
facts.anchor: I keep walking because I refuse to sit there and watch Aria, who’s been here five minutes, smile and talk and get hugged like she already fits, while I’ve been trapped in this house for ten months with permission to speak to exactly one person: Lorraine. I sleep in a tiny box room, and I own three outfits and a single pair of shoes.

facts.fact: Soren 最恼的是这件事钻得太深：不该这么在意、不该看到 Aria 抱着他的记忆还火大。
facts.anchor: What’s pissing me off the most is how deeply this has gotten under my skin. How affected I am; I shouldn’t care this much that he walked out. I shouldn’t care that he looked so goddamn miserable sitting next to me. And I definitely shouldn’t still be seeing red over the memory of Aria’s arms wrapped around him.

facts.fact: So, talk to me.
facts.anchor: “So, talk to me.”

facts.fact: 爆发：你住快一年了，Christopher，你跟我说过的话凑不出一句完整的！
facts.anchor: “Give me something! You’ve lived here almost a year, Christopher, and you’ve barely spoken a single fucking sentence to me!”

facts.fact: 不给我的话，别人也休想得到——Selina、Armen、新来的金发女人都不行。
facts.anchor: If he won’t talk to me, if he won’t give me his voice, then no one else gets it either. Not Selina, not Armen, and not some brand-new blonde who thinks she can just walk in and put her hands on what’s mine.

facts.fact: 我不分享——他的话、他的注意力，一样都不分享。
facts.anchor: I’m not sharing… not his words, not his attention, not a single fucking thing.

facts.fact: Kit 的第一个完整句：你怎么让我跟你说话——你杀了我唯一的家人。
facts.anchor: “How can I talk to you… when you murdered my only family?

facts.fact: Soren 一瞬当机：那是完整的一句话；比起指控本身，他开口这件事更重。
facts.anchor: that was a full sentence; soft and broken, but complete. It’s the last thing I wanted to hear, yet the fact that he spoke at all lands heavier than the accusation itself.

facts.fact: 生日自白：五天前的周一他满二十一；父母会大惊小怪地庆祝；这里没人问过、甚至没人被允许对他笑一下——「你可以要我的身体，但得不到我的话」。
facts.anchor: I was twenty-one five days ago, on Monday. My parents would have made a fuss. They would have acted like it was Christmas Day. But here… no one cared to ask about my birthday. No one was even allowed to smile at me… just one smile would have been nice. So, no… you don’t deserve my words. You can have my body, but not my words.

facts.fact: Soren 惊觉：屋檐下每个人的生日他都记着、纵容一天——全家包括他自己漏掉了 Kit 的。
facts.anchor: And somehow the entire house, myself included, completely missed his.

facts.fact: 这个认知非常不对劲。
facts.anchor: The realisation sits wrong, very wrong.

facts.fact: 他笨拙地问：要不要……我抱你下去？
facts.anchor: “Do you… want me to carry you or something?

facts.fact: 重量贴上来的那一刻，胸腔里某种占有欲深处的的东西松开了。
facts.anchor: something deep and possessive in my chest eases.

facts.fact: 抱着人走进餐厅全桌静默——他从未对任何人这样做过。
facts.anchor: The second we appear the entire table falls silent. Every pair of eyes tracks the highly unusual sight of their usually untouchable boss walking in with a fragile, clearly upset young man held carefully against his chest. I’ve never done this with anyone else, not once.

facts.fact: Aria 起立：原来你们在交往？难怪不让我碰他。
facts.anchor: I didn’t realise you were in a relationship with him.

facts.fact: 他轻敲桌上的音频播放器并点头——Kit 获准戴耳机。
facts.anchor: I just give him a quick, short nod.
